newsitem.title: USA: Stratus Q2 revs accelerated, led by telecom.
newsitem.headline: Stratus Q2 revs accelerated, led by telecom.

text.p: Stratus Computer Inc said that its product revenue growth continued to accelerate in the second quarter, up 31 percent from a year ago, with telecommunications revenues leading the way.

Stratus reported second quarter net income of $17.4 million, or $0.71 a share, up from $4.5 million, or $0.19 a share a year ago. Its earnings were in line with Wall Street forecasts, with First Call consensus of $0.70 a share.
Stratus said that revenues to telecommunications customers represented 48 percent of its product revenues in the quarter.
Stratus's total revenues for the second quarter rose 19 percent to $167.6 million, from $140.3 million a year ago.
Product revenues were $117.4 million, and services were $50.1 million in the second quarter.
